changes.expression: Same NB auxiliary loss and encoder; E_X at training and inference.

changes.scSAMAC: Stable masked-logsumexp implementation on every dataset and all five seeds; 300 pretraining, <=2000 joint epochs; native and L2KMeans20 outputs.

graph_training.attack: Frozen feature-only PGD. Do not add topology PGD to these experiments.
